evidence_spans: For the flat metasurface, the peak voltage increases almost linearly with incident field, reaching approximately 85V at the incident peak field of 150kV/cm.
CLM-DEV-0006.statement: In the flat state of the nanogap metasurface, the peak gap voltage reaches approximately 85 V at an incident peak electric field of 150 kV/cm.

extra_quotes: Details of the nonlinear THz spectroscopy measurements are provided in Section S4 of the Supporting Information.
